title: bulkdeleteoperation
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): asyncoperationid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, owningbusinessunit.

bulkdeleteoperationid.description: Unique identifier of the bulk deletion job.

childrecordsdeletedbreakdown.description: Per-entity breakdown (JSON) of the child records deleted through cascade as part of the bulk delete operation.

childrecordsdeletedcount.description: Total number of child records deleted through cascade as part of the bulk delete operation.

createdon.description: Date and time when the bulk deletion job was created.

failurecount.description: Number of records that could not be deleted by the bulk deletion job.

isrecurring.description: Information about if recurrence is defined for the bulk deletion job.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the bulk deletion job record was last modified.

name.description: Name of the bulk deletion job.

nextrun.description: Next scheduled time for the bulk deletion job to run.

orderedquerysetxml.description: Fetch XML of the ordered query set.

parentbulkdeletepolicyid.description: BulkDeleteOperationId of the parent (recurring) bulk delete policy that this run instance belongs to.

processingqeindex.description: Index of the ordered query expression that defines the deletion set.

statecode.description: Status of the bulk deletion job.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the bulk deletion job.

successcount.description: Number of records deleted by the bulk deletion job.

totalsizecleanedupinbytes.description: Total size in bytes reclaimed by deleting the records and their cascaded child records as part of the bulk delete operation.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_asyncoperationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the system job that created this record

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the bulk deletion job.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the bulkdeleteoperation.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the bulk deletion job.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the bulkdeleteoperation.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Business unit that owns the bulk deletion job.
